message.content:
type:
- Bug fix
description: |
  - Refactor `is_sha` validation checks to use explicit `if` blocks
  - Avoid relying on `||` short-circuit after compound `&&` conditions
  - Applies to both PR import and start/ensure command paths
title: |
  Fix compound condition handling in kk-packet.sh validation checks
changes_diagram: |
  ```mermaid
  flowchart LR
    A["kk-packet.sh"] -- "refactor" --> B["is_sha && is_sha checks"]
    B -- "wrap in if/die blocks" --> C["correct error handling"]
  ```
pr_files:
- filename: |
    skills/engineering-manager/scripts/kk-packet.sh
  changes_summary: |
    - Replaced `cmd1 && cmd2 || die ...` pattern with explicit `if ! { cmd1 && cmd2; }` blocks
    - Fixes potential bug where `die` could trigger even if the compound condition succeeded but had side effects
    - Applied to PR import's base/head SHA validation
    - Applied to start/ensure's review base/head pinned SHA validation
  changes_title: |
    Fix faulty `||` short-circuit logic for compound conditions
  label: |
    bug fix
```
